steps.en: Officer records or updates the warrant of arrest outcome
steps.id: Officer mencatat atau meng-update hasil warrant of arrest
steps.why_en: The system has no screen or storage for recording warrant outcomes.
steps.why_id: Sistem belum punya layar atau penyimpanan untuk mencatat hasil warrant.

steps.en: OCMS picks warrants that have not yet been sent
steps.id: OCMS memilih warrant yang belum dikirim
steps.why_en: No process exists to pick warrants for sending.
steps.why_id: Belum ada proses untuk memilih warrant yang akan dikirim.

steps.en: OCMS builds the update request for State Courts
steps.id: OCMS menyusun request update untuk State Courts
steps.why_en: No request is generated for State Courts.
steps.why_id: Belum ada request yang dibuat untuk State Courts.

steps.en: OCMS sends the request and State Courts processes it
steps.id: OCMS mengirim request dan State Courts memprosesnya
steps.why_en: Nothing connects OCMS to State Courts in these repositories.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi OCMS ke State Courts di repo ini.

steps.en: OCMS marks warrants as sent and records reply errors
steps.id: OCMS menandai warrant terkirim dan mencatat error balasan
steps.why_en: Sent marking and error recording are not built.
steps.why_id: Penandaan terkirim dan pencatatan error belum dibangun.
